title: queue-fill-real: enqueue on-disk multiformat + vlog videos missing from post-queue
rationale: TikTok warmup completes 2026-03-27. go-live.ts (Sprint 1462) shows all 20 post-queue entries as FILE MISSING — their source pipeline runs were cleaned or never written. Meanwhile 6 multiformat videos (mf-20260326T05, mf-20260326T09) and 2 vlog videos (vlog-mn76mml7, vlog-mn772om3) exist on disk with confirmed _final.mp4 / .mp4 files but are NOT in post-queue. Script scans both run-dirs, cross-checks queue, and enqueues real files only.
success_criteria: Script scans all multiformat run-report.json and vlog meta.json
Only enqueues videos where file exists on disk
Newly enqueued videos visible in go-live.ts output with file OK status

tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/queue-fill-real.ts: scan multiformat and vlog run dirs, enqueue on-disk videos not yet in post-queue
